question: How can the same reality appear limited and divided yet whole on the ground of totality?
premises: The reality appears limited and divided on all sides.
It is also seen as whole.
This occurs on the couch of totality.
inference: For the lord of parts, the same reality is both divided and whole depending on the ground of totality.
uncertainties: sākalyatalpe is metaphorical and may imply a specific doctrinal level.
plain_english: O lord of parts, this reality, though limited and divided on all sides, is also whole on the couch of totality.
